title: Sustainability Report Analysis
description: Structured, source-anchored output of the sustainable-manager Document Analysis / Greenwashing Detection workflow. One object per analyzed report. Feeds report-analysis-template.md (human-readable) and analysis_dashboard.py (comparative dashboard). Anti-fabrication rule: every value in key_metrics MUST carry a page and a verbatim quote; if a figure is not in the document it goes in completeness.missing, never in key_metrics.

company.description: Reporting entity legal name (and group/perimeter if relevant).

reporting_period.description: Period the report covers, e.g. 'FY2025 (1 Jan – 31 Dec 2025)'.

source_file.description: Filename or reference of the analyzed document.

pages_read.description: Which pages of the document were actually read, e.g. '1-72 all' or '1-40, 100-120'.

status.description: Reporting status. 'inspired_by' (e.g. 'ispirato agli ESRS') is NOT compliance — keep the distinction explicit.

standards.description: Declared or recognizable standards: GRI, ESRS, VSME, TNFD, SASB, ISSB, UNI/PdR, etc.

type.description: e.g. 'limited assurance, ISAE 3000, SGS Italia', or 'absent'.

key_metrics.description: Quantitative KPIs actually present in the document. For Scope 2 report BOTH market-based and location-based when available (as separate entries).

page.description: Physical page in the file (not the printed page number).

quote.description: Short verbatim quote from the document supporting the value.

missing.description: Expected but absent disclosures (e.g. 'Scope 3', 'external assurance', 'SBTi baseline').

verification.description: OPTIONAL. Populated only when an independent verification pass was run (e.g. /adversarial-verify or a self-check re-reading the source). The core skill does not orchestrate multi-agent verification on its own.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the verified analysis.

hallucinations.description: Count of cited values/pages that do not exist in the document.
